spans.s:
प्लक प्लक, अस्, m., Ved. in कश-प्लकौ,
pudenda muliebria.

प्लक्ष प्लक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
प्लुष्, to burn), the waved-leaf fig-tree or Ficus Infec-
toria (a large and beautiful tree with small white
fruit); the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa; the tree
Hibiscus Populneoides, Thespesia Populneoides; a
side door, private or back door; the space at the
side of a door; one of the seven Dvīpas or continents
into which the world is divided; N. of a man; (आ),
f. a N. of the river Sarasvatī.
—प्लक्ष-जाता, f.
‘rising near the fig-tree,’ an epithet of the Sarasvatī.
—प्लक्ष-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pil-
grimage.
—प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण, अम्, n. ‘the
fig-tree source,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī
[]
takes its rise.
—प्लक्ष-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the
fig-trees,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī becomes
visible.
—प्लक्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, surrounded by
fig-trees (Ficus Infectoria); (अती), f., N. of a river
(perhaps the Sarasvatī).
—प्लक्ष-समुद्र-वा-
चका, f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
—प्लक्ष-
स्रवण, अम्, n., N. of the place where the Saras-
vatī becomes visible; [cf. प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण.]
—प्लक्षावतरण (˚ष-अव्˚), अम्, n., N. of a
place of pilgrimage.

प्लाक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the
waved-leaf fig-tree (Ficus Infectoria); (अम्), n. the
fruit of the waved-leaf fig-tree and of the various
trees called Plaksha; (अस्), m. a patronymic from
Plākṣi.
प्लाक्ष प्लाक्ष, &c. See above.
प्लक्षकीय, see Gaṇa Naḍādi to Pāṇ.
प्लाक्षकि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Plaksha.
प्लाक्षायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plākṣi.
प्लाक्षि, इस्, ई, m. f. a patronymic from Plaksha.
प्लति प्लति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
प्लात, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plati.

प्लब् प्लब् or प्लव्, cl. 1. A. प्लबते, प्ल-
वते, &c., to float, = rt. प्लु, q. v.

प्लयोग प्लयोग (= प्र-योग?), अस्, m., N.
of a man.
प्लायोगि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Āsaṅga.
प्लव प्लव, प्लवक, &c. See col. 2.

प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, swimming, floating; leaping,
jumping, one who goes by leaps or jumps, a tumbler;
superior, excellent (Ved.); (अस्), m. the act of
swimming, floating, diving, bathing [cf. जल-प्˚,
धरणी-प्˚]; flooding, a flood, the swelling of a
river; suffusion, (नयन-प्˚, suffusion or swimming
of the eyes); jumping, leaping, plunging, going by
leaps or plunges; a float, raft, boat, canoe, small
ship; a snare or basket of wicker-work for catching
fish (= पलव); a kind of aquatic bird, Pelicanus
Fusicollis (= गात्र-सम्प्लव); a kind of duck (=
कारण्डव); = जल-वायस; = जल-काक; = जल-
कुक्कुट; a frog; a monkey; a sheep; a man of
low or degraded tribe, a Cāṇḍāla; an enemy; the
waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria (= प्लक्ष); a
kind of weapon; the thirty-fifth (or ninth) year in a
cycle of Jupiter; N. of various Sāmans; the prolated
utterance of a vowel; protracting a sentence through
three or more Ślokas (= कुलक); a kind of metre;
a declivity, slope, shelving ground; proclivity, incli-
nation; returning, return; urging on, inciting;
(अम्), n. a species of grass, Cyperus Rotundus; a
kind of fragrant grass (= गन्ध-तृण); [cf. Gr.
πλόος, πλοῖον; Hib. falc, ‘a flood.’]
—प्लव-ग,
अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog; an ape, monkey;
a sort of aquatic bird, the diver; the plant Acacia
Sirissa (= शिरीष); N. of the charioteer of the Sun;
of a son of the Sun; (आ), f. the sign of the zodiac
Virgo.
—प्लव-गति, इस्, f. going by leaps and
jumps; (इस्), m. a frog.
—प्लवङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘going by leaps,’ an epithet of fire as flickering; (अस्),
m. an ape, baboon, monkey; a deer; the waved-leaf
fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria; N. of the forty-first (or
fifteenth) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter.
—प्लवङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog;
an ape, monkey; (आ), f. a kind of metre.
—प्लवङ्-
गमेन्दु (˚म-इन्˚), उस्, m. ‘moon among the apes,’
an epithet of Hanumat.
—प्लव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessing a ship, owner of a boat.
प्लाव प्लाव, &c. See col. 3.

प्लाव, अस्, m. flowing over; filling a vessel till it
overflows; submersion; jumping.
प्लाय प्लाय. See under प्ले, col. 3.
प्लाय, अस्, m., Ved. = प्राय, abundance, q. v.

प्लाशि प्लाशि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part
of the intestines; (according to Mahī-dhara = शिश्न
or शिश्न-मूल-नाड्यः.)

प्लाशुक प्लाशुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्लाशु =
प्राशु), Ved. growing rapidly; (according to the
Scholiasts) growing again, springing up again.
प्लाशुचित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. quick, speedy; [cf. प्राशु.]

प्लवक, अस्, m. a frog; a tumbler, a dancer, a
man who walks on the edge of a sword, a rope-
dancer, &c.; an outcast, a Cāṇḍāla; the waved-leaf
fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria.
प्लवाका, f. a boat, a raft.

प्लवन, अम्, n. swimming, plunging into,
bathing; a deluge, inundation; jumping, leaping,
plunging; capering, one of a horse's paces; flying;
declivity, inclination; (अस्, आ, अम्), inclined, stooping
down, (at the end of comps.; cf. प्राग्-उदक्-प्˚.)

प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, floating, swimming;
going in a boat, crossing in a boat; bathing; hover-
ing, soaring; blowing (as the wind); fading away,
disappearing; leaping, springing, bounding.

प्लविक, अस्, आ, अम्, ferrying over in a boat, a
ferryman.
प्लवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, leaping, springing, a leaper.

प्लावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to float, flooding,
inundating.

प्लावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to swim,
causing to cross or go in a boat.

प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to float, made to
swim; made to overflow; overflowed, deluged,
inundated, flooded; moistened, soaked; covered
with; [cf. रुधिर-प्˚.]

प्लाविन्, ई, m. spreading, promulgating; (ई), m. a
bird.

1. प्लाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be submerged or inun-
dated; to be steeped or soaked in anything (with
inst.); to be jumped or leaped.

2. प्लाव्य, ind. having caused to float or swim;
having immersed or flooded; having washed away.
